additional_info.subject: Siemens Sicharge D160 with SN 170002926 & 170002927
additional_info.body:
Hello Support,
we are trying to connect two Siemens chargers with our backend.
Chargers are located in Germany, at Große-Vehne Speditions GmbH Rudolf-Diesel-Str. 2 70806 Kornwestheim.
It was reported to us that:
The technician tried to log in with the password and when logging in, the screen went white and the router was no longer accessible. The technician then got the second one router selected and can be reached. The technician then completely restarted the charging station and the router could no longer be reached.
Are you able to see if something has to be done on your side or if there are any errors?
Thank you.
Ticket Nummer: 13122456
Schöne Grüße,
Karolina Jablonska
Technical Support – DACH
How to call us: https://www.chargepoint.com/de-de/support/
Working hours: 08:00-18:00 CET
